name: command-bar
description: Replaces the quick-search (Cmd+K / Ctrl+K) surface with a launcher: type a command, not a query. The first page carries app commands, destinations and system settings and issues no request, so typing costs nothing. Sessions become a row you enter; searching knowledge, artifacts, skills and prompts is not available while this is enabled — disable it to get that back.
author: kirocrew
useCases: Jump to apps, settings, sessions that need attention, or a new agent request without leaving the keyboard.
configuration: It is enabled by default: press Cmd+K or Ctrl+K anywhere, type a command, and use the Sessions scope for recent or matching conversations.
